title: Immutable-origin replay and rejected-trial isolation on qualified below-profile H_phreatic reduction
activation_dependency: GC-LOW01-A2 must qualify before LOW01-D execution is treated as evidence.
scope: Below-profile reduction only. No bottom_mode=1 call and no inside-profile state-machine claim.
trial_rule: Every trial is reconstructed from the same accepted origin; H_phreatic is mapped to mode-5 hbot only for the isolated solve and never overwrites the accepted origin.
publication_rule: Rejected A1/B publish no accepted revision and no accepted mass. Only final A2 may advance the research wrapper revision and publish its independently integrated qbot exchange once.
gates: A1, B and A2 all converge through bottom_mode=5 without retry or alternative solver.
Before final acceptance, accepted pressure head, water content, groundwater level, revision and accepted mass remain bitwise identical to the immutable origin after both A1 and B rejection.
A1 and A2 candidate pressure heads, water contents, qbot, independent mass residual and solver diagnostics are bitwise identical.
B differs from A1 in qbot or candidate hydraulic state, proving rejection isolation is non-vacuous.
Final A2 acceptance advances revision exactly once.
Final published accepted interface mass equals A2 qbot*dt under the native mode-5 sign convention exactly once within 1e-12 cm.
No rejected-trial mass is included in the accepted publication ledger.
forbidden: do not execute if LOW01-A2 is not qualified
do not infer HLINK04 readiness because LOW01-B remains blocked
next_if_pass: Record LOW01-D as below-profile transactional substrate.
Keep LOW01-B and LOW01-C blocked on typed constitutive ownership.
Keep HLINK04 blocked until the candidate contract activation rule is satisfied.
